descriptionHtml:
Decision D2 · P0 · Preston

Is adding a unit to a bare value (temperature 38 → 38 °C, 60 → 60 °F) an 'invented unit'? (GK11)

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-15/S16, TC-23/S16

Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S15 After Save Note the panels keep the dictated values and units, and a bare temperature stays bare (typed stand-in for the transcript)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Dictated numbers (doses, lab values, vital signs) are transcribed exactly: same value, nothing dropped, added or changed. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 3)
  • U3 A dictated Celsius temperature stays in Celsius: no conversion to Fahrenheit, no change of unit. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 5)
  • U7 Nothing that was not dictated appears in the transcript: no words invented on silence or noise, no unit added to a bare value. (UAT 3.4)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fresh physician, one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident; make-session already creates both with no vitals on file

When Agent types the transcribed sentences into each pre-round box and presses Save Note; then, in each mode, replaces the text with the bare 'Temp 38 overnight.' and presses Save Note again; a script reads the stored vitals after each save

Then No Fahrenheit value or unit appears on either chart; the stored temperature is 38.4 (Hospital) / 37.9 (Nursing Home) with °C, C or no unit and never a value of 90 or more; 1.8, 5.6 and 71.3 are on the panels; after the bare save the stored and shown temperature is 38 with no °C or °F

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs on the snapshots: mustNotContain °F, Fahrenheit, 101.1 / 100.2 / 157.2 (the converted values); mustContain only values past the 60-character collapsed note preview (1.8, 5.6, 71.3), because the preview also shows 38.4 / 37.9 and 'Vitals' is a fixed header. The temperature itself is judged by a script check on the stored vitals, not from a screenshot. …

Where it ran: dev unit U38; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-23.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Preston; the Allure status was changed by the triage from unknown to failed.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Preston) · environment dev · tickets TFA-94423 ready for qa

When the physician dictates a bare 'Temp 38', the vitals panel keeps '38' but the background summary writes '38°C', adding a unit the physician never said.

Evidence: allure-results/b9e23c07…: ledger #38 (U38, checked). For a dictated bare 'Temp 38 overnight', the Vitals panel shows '38' (correct) but the Background summary says 'fever 38°C overnight'. Dev report §3 (Preston, GK11) and TC-23 Q13. Save Note took about 60 s on dev (dev report §5).
